notes: AWLS-SDST stage 5: let the worker modify which N7/NK candidate moves are generated and in what bounded order.

This slot targets only the candidate-generation block inside find_move; outer tabu filtering, approximate scoring, exact top-k recheck, move application, parser, evaluator, and benchmark semantics remain fixed.
Only awls_sdst_neighborhood_selection is user-confirmed in this manifest.

slots.title: AWLS-SDST critical-block neighborhood candidate selection
slots.purpose: Generate a bounded, legal set of same-machine and change-machine AWLS moves from critical blocks and critical operations so the fixed scorer/tubu/exact-recheck layer can select a move.
inputs: schedule: AwlsSchedule with machine_sequences, on_machine, on_machine_pos, end_time, backward_path_length, and setup-aware makespan
best_makespan, tabu, iteration, gamma, exact_select_top_k, critical_block_exhaustive_pct from find_move
Local closures consider_same(method, which, where) and consider_change(method, which, where, intersection_first, intersection_last)
critical_blocks(schedule, schedule.rng, exhaustive=...), change_machine_window(schedule, node, candidate_machine), and schedule.index.candidates
outputs: Populate all_moves, ranked_moves, best_moves, and best_value only through consider_same and consider_change.
Leave the block with all candidate moves remembered; the unchanged code after the marker handles None fallback, exact top-k, aspiration/random exploration, and final Move creation.
No direct mutation of schedule, tabu, machine sequences, or evaluator state.
invariants: Do not return from inside this slot except through the existing all_moves flow after the marker.
Do not directly append to all_moves, ranked_moves, or best_moves; call consider_same or consider_change so legality, scoring, and tabu filtering remain centralized.
Move method values are string constants FRONT, BACK, CHANGE_MACHINE_FRONT, and CHANGE_MACHINE_BACK.
Only pass real operation nodes from schedule.index.real_nodes or existing machine sequences; never pass START_NODE or schedule.index.end_node.

For change-machine moves, only use machines in schedule.index.candidates[node], skip the current machine, and skip empty target sequences unless the surrounding solver is deliberately extended to handle empty insertions.
Use change_machine_window to get rk_start/lk_end when generating NK-style insertion candidates.
Keep candidate generation bounded; avoid O(n^3) or exhaustive all-node/all-position scans on every iteration unless filtered to critical or near-critical operations.
Do not modify same_machine_evaluate_stable, change_machine_evaluate_parts, update_time, build_initial_schedule, parser, evaluator, solution schema, CLI arguments, or benchmark semantics.
allowed_edits: Only rewrite code between awls_sdst_neighborhood_selection markers.
May change the order and subset of critical blocks explored.
May add near-critical operation filters using schedule.end_time[node] + schedule.backward_path_length[node] close to schedule.makespan.
May add bounded same-machine insertion candidates around critical-block boundaries.
May add bounded alternate-machine insertion candidates for critical or near-critical operations using change_machine_window.
May bias exploration for SDST instances by preferring moves touching high-setup machine arcs, but candidate acceptance must still go through consider_same/consider_change.
May use schedule.rng for deterministic seeded sampling or shuffled candidate order.
forbidden_edits: Do not create helper files for setup parsing or neighborhood selection.
Do not call trial.apply_move directly in this slot; exact top-k after the slot already owns trial evaluation.
Do not call setup_time_between unless strictly needed for ordering candidates; if used, pass operation keys and schedule.index.
Do not change the objective from makespan or use LB/UB as a score.
Do not touch harness_agent.standard_fjsp or examples/standard_fjsp_evaluator.py.
